text: Chapel wall = two versions of one text? The last group of part 1 is (mbox-sweep box-cross)(fishhook box-cross); the last group of part 2 is (mbox-sweep wide)(fishhook wide). Part 1 has (mbox-pointbelow arrow)(lamp box-cross)(lamp seed)(egg box-cross); part 2 has (box-curl+dot arrow)(lamp wide)(lamp seed)(egg wide). Second-sign box-cross consistently becomes "wide"; seed and arrow stay.
